optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Field Service Operations Manager, Elevator Maintenance Scheduling
professionalSummary: Experienced operations manager with a proven track record of maintaining live dispatch operations for elevator maintenance across the northern region from 2021‑2025. Demonstrated expertise in incident response, production support rota management, vendor change coordination, runbook upkeep, and post‑incident documentation.
experienceHighlights:
• Primary holder of the production support rota for the elevator dispatch desk, overseeing branch escalation routes and duty phone coverage.
• First responder to all production incidents that halted dispatching, including three vendor outages in 2023‑2024.
• Managed vendor scheduling releases during quarterly change windows, documenting acceptance checks separate from vendor regression checks.
• Maintained the dispatch runbook and response‑time metrics for eleven branches, updating them after each incident and release.
• Authored comprehensive post‑incident and hand‑over notes, detailing known limitations and hand‑over conditions.
projectsAndWorkSamples:
• Regional incident log extracts for three vendor outages with ticket numbers.
• Change log for the last four quarterly windows.
• Current dispatch runbook.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume, work samples, and notes establish the candidate’s direct experience and responsibilities related to dispatch system operation, incident response, rota management, vendor change coordination, runbook upkeep, and post‑incident documentation. They do not provide evidence of broader organizational leadership, strategic planning, or cross‑departmental collaboration beyond the dispatch desk context.

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate’s evidence supports all role requirements; human review recommended to confirm fit.

role.roleTitle: Field Service Operations Manager, Elevator Maintenance Scheduling

evidence.text: First responder to every production incident that stopped dispatching in those four years; the three vendor outages of 2023 and 2024 are logged under my name in the regional incident log with the vendor's ticket numbers.
Recruiter screen: candidate described holding the rota, taking the three vendor outage calls and running the change windows; the dates he gave agree with the resume and the incident log extracts.

Primary holder of the production support rota for the elevator dispatch desk in the northern region from 2021 to 2025, with the branch escalation route running through me during working hours and the duty phone outside them.
Brought the vendor's scheduling releases into the live system through the quarterly change window, with the change log recording my acceptance checks separately from the vendor's regression checks.
Kept the dispatch runbook and the response-time figures for the eleven branches current for the service contract reviews, revising the runbook after each incident and each release.
Wrote the post-incident notes and the release hand-over notes, recording the known limitations of the technician availability feed and what the next rota holder needed to know.

supportedClaims.claim: Candidate has maintained live dispatch operations for the elevator maintenance service in the northern region from 2021‑2025.
supportedClaims.witness: Primary holder of the production support rota for the elevator dispatch desk in the northern region from 2021 to 2025, with the branch escalation route running through me during working hours and the duty phone outside them.

supportedClaims.claim: Candidate is experienced in coordinating vendor scheduling releases during quarterly change windows.
supportedClaims.witness: Brought the vendor's scheduling releases into the live system through the quarterly change window, with the change log recording my acceptance checks separately from the vendor's regression checks.

humanReviewChecklist: Confirm candidate’s ability to manage cross‑branch escalation beyond the dispatch desk.
Verify understanding of vendor change acceptance criteria and regression testing processes.
